content_sections.heading: About Panjab University Department of Laws
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Department of Laws of Panjab University, Chandigarh, and signed by its Chairperson. The appointment is to teach LL.B and LL.M. classes in the same department.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice prints no category-wise break-up of the 3 posts.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice states that this qualification is as per the UGC Regulations on Minimum Qualifications for Appointment of Teachers and Other Academic Staff in Universities and Colleges and Measures for the Maintenance of Standards in Higher Education, 2018. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

rows.qualification: Master's degree with 55% marks (50% marks in case of SC/ST) or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed, and UGC-NET or Ph.D. in Law

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Honorarium: Rs. 1500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate must give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are teaching at the Department of Laws, Panjab University, Chandigarh as a Guest Faculty. The notice does not mention the length of the engagement or any allowances.

content_sections.heading: Panjab University Guest Faculty (Law) Job Description
content_sections.text: The appointment is to teach LL.B and LL.M. classes in the Department of Laws, Panjab University, Chandigarh.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Panjab University Guest Faculty (Law)
content_sections.text: The notice asks applicants to send or submit the application to the Department of Laws, Panjab University, Chandigarh. It must reach the department on or before 14 November 2026, by 4:00 pm. The notice gives no separate postal address, email address or start date. Get the application form and template pages 1 to 11 from the link given in the notice: https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf Fill in the application form duly. Attach self-attested copies of certificates and other relevant documents, including publications, for verification. Send or submit the application to the Department of Laws, Panjab University, Chandigarh by 14 November 2026, 4:00 pm. Report on the interview date, which will be notified shortly. Physical presence is mandatory at the interview. The notice asks candidates to keep checking the Panjab University and Department of Laws websites for updates on the interview date.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form and template pages 1 to 11. Self-attested copies of certificates and other relevant documents, including publications. At the interview: all supporting documents, certificates and publications in original. An undertaking that no fellowship, stipend or financial assistance from any agency will be drawn while teaching at the Department of Laws as a Guest Faculty.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Late applications will not be considered. Physical presence of the candidate at the interview is mandatory. The interview date is not yet fixed; it will be notified shortly.

faq.question: Q1. How many Guest Faculty (Law) posts are there in Panjab University?
faq.answer: There are 3 Guest Faculty (Law) posts in the Department of Laws, Panjab University, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Department of Laws on or before 14 November 2026, by 4:00 pm. Late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Guest Faculty (Law)?
faq.answer: A Master's degree with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed, and UGC-NET or Ph.D. in Law, as per the UGC Regulations, 2018.

faq.question: Q4. What is the honorarium for Guest Faculty (Law)?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs. 1500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and template pages 1 to 11, attach self-attested copies of certificates and publications, and send or submit them to the Department of Laws, Panjab University, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q6. Which classes will the Guest Faculty teach?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty will teach LL.B and LL.M. classes in the Department of Laws, Panjab University, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be an interview?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice calls for an interview. The date will be notified shortly, and physical presence is mandatory.

faq.question: Q8. What should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring all supporting documents, certificates and publications in original.

faq.question: Q9. Can a Guest Faculty draw a fellowship or stipend at the same time?
faq.answer: No. The candidate must give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship, stipend or financial assistance from any agency while teaching as Guest Faculty at the Department of Laws.
